backend.description: Use for backend API routes, database store, and server logic

frontend.description: Use for React frontend components, pages, and services

env.description: Environment variable template with DB, API keys, and server config

deploy.description: Full deployment workflow - SSH host, deploy steps, and server setup
Build frontend, copy backend, restart server, and run post-deploy tasks
deploy.template: Run git push to main — the GitHub Actions deploy workflow handles: 1) npm ci + build frontend, 2) SCP dist to server, 3) copy backend, 4) npm ci --omit=dev, 5) write .env from secrets, 6) restart systemd service, 7) health check, 8) nginx reload. Full pipeline: .github/workflows/deploy.yml

ssh.template: Connect via SSH: ssh -p $DEPLOY_PORT $DEPLOY_USER@$DEPLOY_HOST (credentials in GitHub Secrets / your local SSH config)

db-query.description: Run a SQL query on the production database
db-query.template: SSH into server and run: PGPASSWORD=$DB_PASSWORD psql -h $DB_HOST -p $DB_PORT -U $DB_USER -d $DB_NAME -c "$ARGUMENTS"

db-psql.description: Open interactive psql shell on the production database
db-psql.template: SSH into server and run: PGPASSWORD=$DB_PASSWORD psql -h $DB_HOST -p $DB_PORT -U $DB_USER -d $DB_NAME

logs.template: SSH into server and run: journalctl -u isp-portal.service --no-pager -n 100

restart.description: Restart the backend service on the server
restart.template: SSH into server and run: sudo systemctl restart isp-portal.service && sleep 3 && curl -fs http://127.0.0.1:4100/health

health.description: Check backend health on the server
health.template: SSH into server and run: curl -fs http://127.0.0.1:4100/health

server-ls.description: List files/directories on the remote server at a given path
server-ls.template: SSH into server and run: ls -la $ARGUMENTS

server-cat.description: View the contents of a file on the remote server
server-cat.template: SSH into server and run: cat $ARGUMENTS

server-disk.description: Check disk usage on the remote server
server-disk.template: SSH into server and run: df -h && echo '---' && du -sh /home/speed4you/* /var/www/* 2>/dev/null

server-find.description: Find files on the remote server matching a pattern
server-find.template: SSH into server and run: find $ARGUMENTS

server-download.description: Download a file from the remote server to local temp directory
server-download.template: SSH into server and run: cat $ARGUMENTS (then pipe output to local file)

search-content.description: Search for content on the site by title keyword

content-detail.description: Get full details of a content item by ID

scan-summary.description: View the last scan summary (created/updated/deleted counts)

webhook-scan.description: Trigger a scan remotely via webhook
webhook-scan.template: POST to https://speed4you.net/portal-api/api/webhook/scan with header x-webhook-secret (configured in .env as WEBHOOK_SECRET)
